summary: Use PX4 SIH, run from the ready image px4io/px4-sitl (51 MB download, 6 MB RAM). It gives true pose, real EKF2 and control, IMU/baro/mag noise, GNSS you can switch off, and wind you can change in flight with PARAM_SET (SIH_WIND_N/E, added in v1.18). SIH wind only enters the first-order drag term, so build gusts in your script. I tested the whole loop on this laptop: GNSS off, arm and climb in Altitude mode, truth-fed vision, Position mode hold, wind step. Gazebo Harmonic also runs headless in Docker with no GPU, but its truth through PX4 is only about 50 Hz and found no working runtime wind topic (the windy world SDF does push the x500). jMAVSim is removed from main and Gazebo Classic is community-only on Ubuntu 22.04, so skip both. Ground truth comes from HIL_STATE_QUATERNION (MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL): 185 to 200 msg per sim second at the default 250 Hz step, about 297 at IMU_INTEG_RATE=400. Use PX4's sim clock (time_usec) in your program; PX4 ignores your vision timestamp unless TIMESYNC converged. Use pymavlink, not MAVSDK-Python (PyPI "mavsdk" is now a different package). Start containers with a trailing "-d" or pxh spins at 100% CPU and floods the log.

facts.claim: PX4 SIH SITL container image size (compressed, amd64)
facts.value: px4io/px4-sitl: 51 MB download, 53 MB content, 180 MB on disk; Gazebo image px4io/px4-sitl-gazebo 667-688 MB download, 3.1 GB on disk
SIH_MASS 1.0 kg; SIH_IXX/IYY/IZZ 0.025/0.025/0.03 kg m^2; SIH_L_ROLL/L_PITCH 0.2 m; SIH_T_MAX 5.0 N per prop; SIH_Q_MAX 0.1 Nm; SIH_KDV 1.0 N/(m/s); SIH_KDW 0.025; SIH_T_TAU 0.05 s
SIH_WIND_N, SIH_WIND_E (m/s); added in v1.18 (PR #26467); absent in v1.17.0
v_apparent = v + wind; SIH_WIND_N=5 pushes drone south; test step gave -1.88 m peak excursion in Position mode; drag only, no gusts, no vertical wind

facts.claim: Wind can change in flight in SIH
facts.value: Yes: PARAM_SET of SIH_WIND_N/E over MAVLink during flight took effect (tested)
IMU accel 0.1 m/s^2, gyro 0.01 rad/s per axis; baro 1 Pa RMS (about 0.08 m) and drift 0 by default; mag 0.02/0.02/0.03
SYS_HAS_GPS=0 (reboot), SIM_GPS_USED=0, EKF2_GPS_CTRL=0, EKF2_HGT_REF=0; SIH also SENS_EN_GPSSIM=0 (not tested)
EKF2_EV_CTRL default 0 (bit0 horiz pos, bit1 vert pos, bit2 3D vel, bit3 yaw); EKF2_EVP_NOISE 0.1 m; EKF2_EV_DELAY 0 ms
Stabilized: none; Altitude: local alt (baro); Position: local_position_relaxed (needs vision); Offboard: attitude only; Takeoff/Hold/Mission need position

facts.claim: Arming test with GNSS off in SIH
facts.value: Altitude mode arm and climb worked with no GNSS and no vision, no GCS heartbeat needed; MANUAL_CONTROL z=900 for 10 s gave +10.4 m

facts.claim: Arming in Gazebo needs GCS heartbeat
facts.value: Without MAV_TYPE_GCS heartbeats: 'Preflight Fail: No connection to the GCS', arming denied
HIL_STATE_QUATERNION (id 115), time_usec = PX4 clock; lat/lon 1e-7 deg, alt mm; no local x,y; no GROUND_TRUTH message
command_long_send(sys, comp, 511, 0, 115, 4000, 0,0,0,0,0) (MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL); or px4-mavlink stream -u 14580 -s HIL_STATE_QUATERNION -r 200

facts.claim: Measured SIH truth rate over MAVLink
facts.value: Default 250 Hz step: 184-201 msg per sim second (4 ms or 8 ms gaps); IMU_INTEG_RATE=400: about 297 per sim second

facts.claim: SIH sim step and speed factor
facts.value: Step = 1e6/min(IMU_GYRO_RATEMAX, IMU_INTEG_RATE) us, clamped 500-5000 us (250 Hz default); PX4_SIM_SPEED_FACTOR=5 achieved 2.4x in test
Timesync::sync_stamp returns PX4 arrival time unless TIMESYNC converged, then usec+offset
About 74-76 msg/s (20 ms steps) because SceneBroadcaster dynamic_pose_hertz default is 60

recommendations: Run the test on px4io/px4-sitl (SIH) with --network host and a trailing '-d'; set GNSS off with PX4_PARAM_SYS_HAS_GPS=0 PX4_PARAM_SIM_GPS_USED=0 PX4_PARAM_EKF2_GPS_CTRL=0 PX4_PARAM_EKF2_HGT_REF=0 PX4_PARAM_EKF2_EV_CTRL=1 (add bit 2 for velocity if you send it)
Set SIH_MASS, SIH_IXX/IYY/IZZ, SIH_T_MAX, SIH_L_ROLL/L_PITCH, SIH_KDV to the Orqa M2-AI values and MPC_THR_HOVER to mass*9.81/(4*SIH_T_MAX); keep CA_* consistent with SIH_*
Generate gusts in the Python script: write SIH_WIND_N/E with PARAM_SET at 5-20 Hz from a filtered random process plus steps; 5 m/s with KDV=1.0 and 1 kg is 5 N (about 27 deg tilt), so tune KDV

Ground truth: request HIL_STATE_QUATERNION with MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL; set IMU_INTEG_RATE=400 for about 300 msg/s; keep time_usec and interpolate (slerp) the pose at each rolling-shutter row time; convert lat/lon with SIH_LOC_LAT0/LON0/H0 or read exact x,y with px4-listener

Pace the host loop by the sim clock (HIL_STATE_QUATERNION.time_usec), not wall time; send vision messages with the camera frame time in that clock and set EKF2_EV_DELAY for camera plus processing delay; do not rely on TIMESYNC
Run at 1x for the first closed-loop tests; if you use PX4_SIM_SPEED_FACTOR, read the achieved factor (simulator_sih status) because 5x requested gave 2.4x

Use pymavlink (pip install pymavlink) with MANUAL_CONTROL at 25 Hz, Altitude mode to climb (z=900 up, 500 hold), then Position mode once vision is fused; decode INT32 params with struct (EKF2_EV_CTRL returned bit-cast floats); send a 1 Hz GCS heartbeat if you ever use Gazebo
Add your own extra baro noise and height bias to the test; SIH baro noise is only 1 Pa (about 0.08 m) with no propwash
Keep the first test truth-fed only as a plumbing check (it passed); replace the vision feed with your hold.py output and compare against HIL truth for drift
Use Gazebo only if a physics effect you need is missing in SIH; if so use PX4_GZ_WORLD=windy and add a pose or odometry publisher plugin for more than 60 Hz truth
